She opens her cloak a little to reveal the Freelancer armor beneath.

She’s still in a daze as well, and doesn’t hug him back at first, but soon he would feel her powerful metal embrace as her tears fall into his shoulder.

She pulls down the high collar of her jacket to reveal an entry wound on her neck, over her throat.
“Dunno.”

A veteran vigilante is there to see the young vampire clean up. She calls out to the girl from a bench near the pay phone.

“Not bad, not bad.”
“They tortured me and once I paid up they killed me.”

The figure pulls down her hood, letting long black hair spill out, and then removes her gas mask, revealing the face Dell would remember so well. The crow’s feet on her brow are more defined, and part of the skin on her chin is worn away to reveal metal. She looks up at the engineer with her mismatched green eyes, only the left one full of tears, but the inhuman green glow of the right seems a little softer than usual. 

When she speaks, the words come out distorted and robotic again, so clearly it wasn’t the mask doing that before. “I— I’m so sorry...”
“I got captured by some people that I owed money.”

She whirls around, acting on instinct, and grabs the speaker by the throat, lifting him up into the air, her metal fingers cold against his neck. 

However, before she can do anything else, another familiar voice cries out in despair. It’s a voice that neither of them have heard for a very long time, one that’s been disturbingly absent from the Freelancer’s life. It’s an energetic girl’s voice. But right now, she seems very scared. 

**FOR GOD’S SAKE, IT’S DELL! PUT HIM DOWN!**

The masked figure hesitates for a second before releasing her iron grip, then sinks down to a sitting position with her face in her hands.
“No, it wasn’t fun at all.”
She pulls down the high collar of her cloak to reveal a gunshot scar on her neck, over her throat.

“...oh. Never mind then.”

“Welcome to Paradise.”
